comment: The Tag Cloud page end to end, after scripts/tagcloud-probe.mjs seeded the sandbox: the Library tools link, the packed cloud, a word's titles as library cards with their filters, sort and count (checked against the server's own filtered page), the picture card when the mouse rests on an actor and on a title of a held word's cloud, narrowing, the words slider, the settings panel (Rows and back), a saved cloud, the full-screen view and Esc. It deletes the cloud it saved and leaves the look as it found it.

steps.name: Library tools links the Tag Cloud
clear the look of earlier runs
steps.script: localStorage.removeItem('jftc:look'); return true;

steps.name: the page as drawn
steps.script: var words = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word'), function (t) { return t.textContent; }); return { title: document.title, words: words.length, summary: document.querySelector('.jftc-summary').textContent, sources: Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-seg')[0].children, function (b) { return b.textContent; }), header: Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-card-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent; }) };

steps.message: the six sources, in the toolbar's order

steps.name: click a word
steps.script: var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word[role=button]'); window.__clicked = t.getAttribute('data-key'); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); return window.__clicked;

steps.name: its titles are shown as library cards
the title cards
steps.script: var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-titles .card.portraitCard')); return { cards: cards.length, linked: cards.filter(function (c) { var a = c.querySelector('a.cardImageContainer'); return a && (a.getAttribute('href') || '').indexOf('#/details?id=') === 0; }).length, named: cards.filter(function (c) { return c.querySelector('.cardText-first').textContent.length > 0; }).length, list: document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-titles [role=listitem]').length };

steps.message: every card opens its title's details page and shows its name; no list rows
the selection is in the hash

steps.name: scroll to the titles
steps.script: document.querySelector('.jftc-titles').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return true;

steps.name: the posters are drawn
steps.waitFor: Array.prototype.some.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-titles .card img'), function (i) { return i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0; }) || !document.querySelector('.jftc-titles .card img')

steps.name: the filter and sort controls above the titles
steps.script: var f = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles .jftc-title-filters'); return { search: !!f.querySelector('input[type=search]'), sort: Array.prototype.map.call(f.querySelectorAll('select[aria-label="Sort by"] option'), function (o) { return o.textContent; }), direction: Array.prototype.map.call(f.querySelectorAll('.jftc-title-direction button'), function (b) { return b.textContent + (b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' ? '*' : ''); }), resolution: Array.prototype.map.call(f.querySelectorAll('select[aria-label="Resolution"] option'), function (o) { return o.value; }), unwatched: !!f.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]') && /Unwatched only/.test(f.textContent), resetHidden: document.querySelector('.jftc-title-reset').classList.contains('hide'), count: document.querySelector('.jftc-titles-count').textContent, cards: document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-titles .card.portraitCard').length };

steps.assert: __vars.filters.search && __vars.filters.sort.join(',') === 'Name,Release date,Date added,Rating' && __vars.filters.direction.join(',') === 'A to Z*,Z to A' && __vars.filters.resolution.join(',') === 'Any,P480,P720,P1080,P4K' && __vars.filters.unwatched && __vars.filters.resetHidden
steps.message: a filter box, Sort by (four), A to Z on, Resolution (movies), Unwatched only, and no Reset while nothing is changed
the count says how many titles the word has

steps.name: type a name no title has
steps.script: var i = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles input[type=search]'); i.value = 'zzqx-none'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('search')); return true;

steps.name: none match: 0 of N, and the note says so
Reset
steps.script: document.querySelector('.jftc-title-reset').click(); return true;

steps.name: every title is back, and Reset goes
sort by date added
steps.script: var s = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles select[aria-label="Sort by"]'); s.value = 'DateAdded'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true;

steps.name: the direction says itself for dates
steps.waitFor: Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-title-direction button'), function (b) { return b.textContent; }).join(',') === 'Oldest first,Newest first'

steps.name: Newest first, Unwatched only, 1080p and up
steps.script: document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-title-direction button')[1].click(); var u = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles input[type=checkbox]'); u.checked = true; u.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); var r = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles select[aria-label="Resolution"]'); r.value = 'P1080'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true;

steps.name: the list follows, and the choices are kept for this user on this device
steps.waitFor: (function () { var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('jftc:titles:' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId()) || 'null'); return v && v.Sort === 'DateAdded' && v.Descending === true && v.Unwatched === true && v.MinResolution === 'P1080' && /^[\d,]+ of [\d,]+ movies?$|^[\d,]+ movies?$/.test(document.querySelector('.jftc-titles-count').textContent) && document.querySelector('.jftc-title-direction button[aria-pressed="true"]').textContent === 'Newest first'; })()

steps.name: the server's answer to the same filters
steps.script: var key = document.querySelector('.jftc-titles-title').textContent; var p = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.split('?')[1]); return ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Titles', { source: p.get('source') || 'Tags', scope: p.get('scope') || 'Movies', key: p.get('sel'), sort: 'DateAdded', descending: true, minResolution: 'P1080', unwatched: true, limit: 50 })).then(function (r) { return { total: r.Total, unfiltered: r.Unfiltered, shown: document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-titles .card').length, count: document.querySelector('.jftc-titles-count').textContent }; });

steps.message: the cards and the count are the server's filtered page

steps.name: Reset again
steps.script: document.querySelector('.jftc-title-reset').click(); return true;

steps.waitFor: (function () { var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('jftc:titles:' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId()) || 'null'); return v && v.Sort === 'Name' && !v.Descending && !v.Unwatched && v.MinResolution === 'Any'; })()

steps.name: the Actors cloud
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-seg')[0].children, function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Actors'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: rest the mouse on a name
steps.params: (function () { var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word'); t.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); var r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__peekAt = { x: Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2), y: Math.round(r.top + r.height / 2) }; return { type: 'mouseMoved', x: window.__peekAt.x, y: window.__peekAt.y }; })()

steps.name: the person's card shows by the pointer
the card
steps.script: window.__peekWord = document.elementFromPoint(window.__peekAt.x, window.__peekAt.y).closest('text'); var c = document.querySelector('.jftc-peek'); var r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return { name: c.querySelector('.jftc-peek-name').textContent, detail: (c.querySelector('.jftc-peek-detail') || {}).textContent, img: !!c.querySelector('img'), icon: !!c.querySelector('.jftc-peek-icon'), word: window.__peekWord.lastChild.textContent, tooltip: window.__peekWord.querySelector('title').textContent, inside: r.left >= 0 && r.top >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth && r.bottom <= innerHeight, pointerEvents: getComputedStyle(c).pointerEvents };

steps.message: the card names the person with their count, a photo (or an icon), inside the window, and the word's own tooltip is set aside

steps.name: the card goes and the tooltip is back
back to Tags
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-seg')[0].children, function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Tags'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: press and hold a word
steps.params: (function () { var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word[role=button]'); t.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); var r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__holdAt = { x: Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2), y: Math.round(r.top + r.height / 2) }; return { type: 'mousePressed', x: window.__holdAt.x, y: window.__holdAt.y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 }; })()

steps.name: let go
steps.params: ({ type: 'mouseReleased', x: window.__holdAt.x, y: window.__holdAt.y, button: 'left', clickCount: 1 })

steps.name: rest the mouse on a title
steps.params: (function () { var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-spotlight .jftc-svg text.jftc-word'); window.__peekTitle = t; var r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return { type: 'mouseMoved', x: Math.round(r.left + r.width / 2), y: Math.round(r.top + r.height / 2) }; })()

steps.name: the poster loaded
steps.waitFor: (function () { var i = document.querySelector('.jftc-peek img'); return !i || (i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0); })()

steps.name: scrolling puts it away
steps.script: window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); return !document.querySelector('.jftc-peek');

steps.name: move away and close the titles' cloud
right-click a word narrows the cloud
steps.script: var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word[role=button]'); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return t.getAttribute('data-key');

steps.name: Show all
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-narrowing button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Show all'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: the words slider to 25
steps.script: var r = document.querySelector('.jftc-words'); r.value = '25'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return r.max + '/' + r.step;

steps.name: the cloud shows the words asked for
open the settings
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-toolbar button'), function (b) { return /Settings/.test(b.textContent); })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: Rows
steps.script: var s = document.querySelector('.jftc-settings select[aria-label="Arrangement"]'); s.value = 'Flow'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true;

steps.name: back to Cloud, and Done
steps.script: var s = document.querySelector('.jftc-settings select[aria-label="Arrangement"]'); s.value = 'Packed'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-settings-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Done'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: open Save cloud
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-saved button'), function (b) { return /Save cloud/.test(b.textContent); })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: Save
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-settings-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Save'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: its pill shows, as the current cloud
Full screen
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-card-actions button'), function (b) { return /Full screen/.test(b.textContent); })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: the full-screen view covers the window with the cloud alone
steps.waitFor: (function () { var v = document.querySelector('.jftc-show'); if (!v || v.querySelectorAll('.jftc-svg text.jftc-word').length === 0) return false; var r = v.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= innerWidth - 1 && r.height >= innerHeight - 1 && /show=1/.test(location.hash) && v.querySelectorAll('.jftc-toolbar, .jftc-saved').length === 0; })()

steps.message: no toast over the full-screen view

steps.name: the exit button and pointer hide when idle
clean up: the saved cloud and the look
steps.script: return ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds')).then(function (list) { return Promise.all(list.filter(function (x) { return x.IsMine && x.Name === 'Webcheck cloud'; }).map(function (x) { return ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds/' + x.Id) }); })); }).then(function () { return ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds')); }).then(function (left) { localStorage.removeItem('jftc:look'); localStorage.removeItem('jftc:titles:' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId()); return left.filter(function (x) { return x.IsMine; }).length; });
